Note that, in the proof of Lemma 12, we constructed very speciﬁc K-fat (K3, K1,3)-minors.
In our K-fat K3-minor, the connected subgraphs H1, H2, H3 are disks. In our K-fat K1,3-
minor, the connected subgraphs H1, H2, H3 are singletons and the paths Pi,0, i = 1, 2, 3, are
shortest paths. Even more speciﬁc K-fat (K3, K1,3)-minors were obtained in [1]. It was shown
that if a graph G contains no (≥K)-subdivision of K3 as a geodesic subgraph and no (≥3K)-
subdivision of K1,3 as a 3-quasi-geodesic subgraph, then pb(G) ≤18K + 2 (see [1] for details
and deﬁnitions).
